welcome.text: Let's look inside Greed Machine. We will start with the app's simulation.

cycle.text: Start a cycle. Scouts propose strategies, and the swarm debates the evidence.

security.text: Security checks each proposal. Here, stale data blocks funding.

payouts.text: Follow the holder payments. This failed payment stays protected, then succeeds on retry.

proof.text: Now open the separate NEAR testnet proof. These links show real demo token transfers.

results.text: Holders received eight point four five demo dollars. The treasury retained four point five five.

verify.text: Verify the finalized balances. This reads existing evidence; it does not send new payments.

limits.text: Demo dollars are unbacked. Returns are fixtures. Production economics remain open.
